d:
Bhagvan shri ganesh ki bhakti men lin ho jaie aur shankar mahadevan ki madhur aavaz men sunie “shri ganesh dhun”. ganesh chaturthi ke pavan avsar par bappa ka smaran karen aur apne jivan men sukh, shanti aur sakaratmak oorja ka svagat karen. ganapti bappa morya!

Track: Shree Ganesh Dhun
Artist: Shankar Mahadevan

Lyrics:
• Om namo shri ganeshay ||[x4]
